<!-- ticket_id: 315fa03a-23de-48d0-9bd1-03b13d4ea4e6 | message_id: b85ca63c-d22a-4f5c-811c-9d1c0e479344 | source: faculty_verified --> Category: it_support ## Q: I am having trouble connecting to Campus-Student-Secure wifi from my laptop and cannot access the internal library VPN portal. To connect to Campus-Student-Secure: 1. Select SSID 'Campus-Student-Secure' and choose EAP Method: PEAP with MSCHAPv2. 2. Use your student ID as username and your portal password. 3. For library VPN, visit https://vpn.university.edu and authenticate.
